name: Christ Centered
overview: Scripture calls believers to place their complete trust in the LORD rather than their own understanding, finding strength and protection in Him (Psalms 28:7; Proverbs 3:5). A Christ-centered life prioritizes seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, assuring that our needs will be met (Matthew 6:33). This transformation involves a renewal of the mind to discern God's perfect will and living by faith in Christ, who lives within us and gave Himself for our salvation (Romans 12:2; Galatians 2:20). Such confidence in God's unchanging power sustains believers through all circumstances, both present and future (Romans 8:38).
